## Quick CLI & GitHub Action Usage

```bash
npx github:zColdWater/inboxshield-cli check stripe.com
```

```yaml
- uses: zColdWater/inboxshield-cli@v1
  with:
    domain: yourdomain.com
    min-score: "80"
```
